name: Le Meridien Munich
positioning: Art-focused city-center hotel opposite Munich Central Station, with a green courtyard, a 750-square-meter spa and complimentary MUCA museum access
best_for: Art lovers who want complimentary entry to MUCA, the Museum of Urban and Contemporary Art
Travelers who want to step straight off the train into the city center
Oktoberfest visitors who want to walk to the fairgrounds

facts.text: Curated design elements of contemporary art surround guests in the lobby.
The LM Hub lobby offers views to the green courtyard.
Rooms measure a minimum of 28 square meters (301 square feet).
Rooms have acoustic insulation and blackout curtains.
The Junior Suite has a walk-in closet.
The Executive Suite has a separate living room and a guest bathroom.
The hotel has an indoor heated pool.
IRMI is a modern Bavarian restaurant in the hotel.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Oktoberfest fairgrounds.
Stachus Square, the entrance to Munich's pedestrian area, is 5 minutes from the hotel.
Munich Central Station across the street makes day trips to lakes, mountains and Neuschwanstein Castle easy.

highlights.text: Through the Unlock Art program, hotel guests get complimentary access to MUCA, Germany's first museum dedicated to urban and contemporary art.
Le SPA Munich covers 750 square meters, with massages, facials, a pool and a sauna.
The hotel is in Munich's city center, directly opposite the Central Train Station.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the city or of the green courtyard.
In the warm months the hotel's courtyard becomes IRMI's beer garden.

considerations.text: Munich Airport is about 35 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury city-center hotels.
